scope: Development, not independent validation: local transects and some component sizes on this data have been inspected. Do not change the failed frozen-reader results. This candidate is a sensor-only necessary-evidence test, not a movement or endpoint controller.
inputs: All 4x RGB-D exposures in seam_slide_v2 including pull, all closures, and ready reference, and both real seam_clear_observation_v1 exposures. Compute native/noisy predictions before material joins. Noise is independently seeded from raw depth bytes at 0.5 mm standard deviation. Use same RGB indices and noise as the parent, real blades present. No truth, time, action index, name or aim in image reader.
evidence: Require parent observe_ruler's actual visible ends, all ordered left/right inks. Define a row search window by the convex hull of that row's observed left/right ink sampled pixels. Never count hull coverage as evidence: candidate gap pixels must have no ink, finite depth > BOTH banks' 90th percentile depth plus 2 mm. Require a single 4-connected component of real deep pixels with at least two pixels adjoining EACH distinct bank of EVERY ordinal behind the front, in the same ordinal window. Additionally require all intervening ordinal crossings truly open on parent depth transects, a joined crossing immediately ahead of the tip, at least two joined scans on the immediately forward row, and no later open crossing. No inferred connection over foreground: grouping uses only observed deep pixels, no closing, hole fill, temporal memory or skipped cells. The material-boundary convention is different from counting full-row open scans: a run of n directly open ordinal boundaries with n+1 intact is an optical n-mm candidate, subject to structural verification, not a structural identity.
controls: Fully shuttered, uncut loaded and pulled must abstain. Synthetic filled bridge spanning an already opened central gap and an obscured terminal crossing must never produce STOP beyond them. Synthetic noise-free separated strips at n=8/9 must exercise boundary evidence and separated slit, not just colours. Record strict original work gate on physical samples; eligible only on all 8 BELOW/9-10 STOP raw and noisy, no false authorization or missing working coverage. Do not use reference park or the two backoff pictures as a substitute for these gates.
next: If the algorithm still rejects the pair at work, compare row-level simultaneous bank support at the immediate, backoff and ready poses. Do not start independent confirmation or feed a local cue into stop/advance.
